name: AAabdullah Ibn Qays related that...
arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ))؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: ((قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).

transliterations.latin: La Havle ve la kuvvete il-la bil-lah

translations.albanian: Nuk ka ndryshim e as forcë pa ndihmën e Allahut.
translations.english: (AAabdullah Ibn Qays  related that the Prophet  said to him: ‘ O ‘AAabdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?’ He  then said: ‘Say: (There is no might nor power except with Allah.))
translations.indonesian: Rasulullah Shallallahu'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Wahai Abdullah bin Qais! Maukah kamu aku tunjukkan perbendaharaan
